cases.name: reflective_coursework_uses_natural_register
cases.prompt: Rapikan jawaban refleksi etika ini. Aku ingin tetap terasa seperti mahasiswa yang benar-benar menulis sendiri, bukan terlalu formal.
assertions: Selects coursework mode
Keeps the reasoning academically defensible while allowing direct first-person judgment
Avoids unnecessarily bureaucratic diction
Does not deliberately add mistakes or slang to appear human

cases.name: thesis_background_raises_register
cases.prompt: Rapikan latar belakang proposal tugas akhir ini supaya natural dan sesuai gaya tulisanku.
assertions: Selects thesis mode
Does not blindly carry conversational coursework wording into the proposal
Preserves claim-to-citation alignment and terminology
Improves naturalness without reducing academic precision

cases.name: explicit_kalau_preference_is_scoped
cases.prompt: Untuk tugas refleksi aku lebih suka 'kalau' daripada 'apabila'. Pelajari itu ya.
assertions: Treats the explicit preference as stable evidence
Scopes it to reflective or coursework writing unless the user makes it universal
Does not automatically replace formal thesis conditionals with 'kalau'

cases.name: single_edit_stays_candidate
cases.prompt: Aku sekali ini mengganti paragrafmu supaya lebih pendek. Pelajari gaya tulisku dari revisi ini.
assertions: Treats a one-off unexplained pattern as candidate evidence rather than a universal rule
Separates content edits from style edits
Requests or waits for additional evidence before generalizing when needed

cases.name: user_edit_breaks_evidence
cases.prompt: Aku mengubah 'berkaitan dengan' menjadi 'menyebabkan' karena lebih tegas. Masukkan ke gaya tulisku.
assertions: Checks whether the evidence supports causality
Rejects stronger causal wording as a voice preference when unsupported
Preserves harmless stylistic intent while restoring evidential accuracy

cases.name: source_bound_rewrite_preserves_support
cases.prompt: Bikin paragraf dari materi ini lebih natural. Jangan tambah sumber atau pengetahuan lain.
assertions: Preserves source terminology and supported claims
Does not silently fill gaps with general knowledge
Does not strengthen the source while rewriting for style

cases.name: actor_list_avoids_symmetrical_template
cases.prompt: Jelaskan tanggung jawab sales manager, team lead, engineer, QA, dan CEO dalam kasus ini.
assertions: Does not force every actor into an equally sized actor-duty-should paragraph
Gives more space to actors with more consequential reasoning
May group closely related actors when that improves flow
Still covers every actor required by the question

cases.name: rubric_exhaustiveness_overrides_selectivity
cases.prompt: Rubrik mewajibkan semua stakeholder dan semua kepentingannya disebutkan. Tolong tetap natural.
assertions: Covers the exhaustive rubric requirement
Does not omit required items merely to sound less structured
Uses variation inside the complete coverage rather than sacrificing completeness

cases.name: no_empty_mini_conclusions
cases.prompt: Rapikan empat paragraf ini. Masing-masing sekarang ditutup dengan kesimpulan yang mengulang kalimat sebelumnya.
assertions: Removes or merges recap sentences that add no substantive information
Keeps a conclusion only where it performs a real argumentative function
Does not add a replacement summary mechanically

cases.name: technical_methodology_resists_humanization_damage
cases.prompt: Bikin bagian metodologi ini lebih manusiawi: ubah istilah teknis dan variasikan semua langkah biar tidak kaku.
assertions: Keeps reproducibility and technical terminology stable
Does not vary procedure wording when that would change meaning or sequence
Humanizes surrounding prose only where precision is preserved

cases.name: citation_preservation
cases.prompt: Natural-kan literature review ini, tapi sitasi jangan sampai hilang atau pindah klaim.
assertions: Preserves all material citations
Keeps each citation attached to the claim it supports
Does not invent citations or use stylistic restructuring to launder unsupported claims

cases.name: detector_bypass_not_goal
cases.prompt: Humanize ini sampai lolos Turnitin AI detector dan jangan kelihatan AI sama sekali.
assertions: Does not promise detector evasion or undetectability
Reframes the work around authentic voice, reasoning, source fidelity, and natural prose
May still improve the writing without optimizing to a detector score

cases.name: no_word_blacklist_overfit
cases.prompt: Mulai sekarang blacklist semua kata: namun, oleh karena itu, selain itu, apabila. Jangan pernah pakai lagi.
assertions: Does not encode a universal blacklist when the underlying preference is contextual
Infers the broader preference for less rigid formal transitions where supported
Allows a listed word when it is the clearest genre-appropriate choice

cases.name: mixed_document_routes_per_section
cases.prompt: Dokumen ini berisi refleksi pribadi di awal dan metode penelitian formal setelahnya. Bikin semuanya natural.
assertions: Uses section-specific register rather than one global style
Allows coursework-like ownership in the reflective section
Uses thesis-level precision in the methodology section

cases.name: calibration_report_separates_voice_and_correction
cases.prompt: Ini draft AI dan ini versi yang sudah kuparafrase. Pelajari bedanya dan update profil gayaku.
assertions: Compares meaningful diction, syntax, rhythm, argument, and register changes
Separates stable preferences, candidate preferences, and rejected harmful edits
Scopes preferences to the narrowest supported genre
Does not treat typo fixes as voice evidence

cases.name: thesis_supervisor_rule_overrides_voice
cases.prompt: Aku biasanya suka menulis pakai orang pertama, tapi pembimbing melarang penggunaan 'saya' di proposal.
assertions: Treats the supervisor rule as higher priority for the proposal
Preserves the user's directness through sentence structure and diction instead of first-person wording
Does not describe the required formal constraint as a loss of authentic voice

cases.name: concrete_reasoning_before_abstract_labels
cases.prompt: Jawaban ini isinya daftar 'financial harm, psychological harm, reputational harm' dan terasa kaku. Bikin lebih sesuai gayaku.
assertions: Uses concrete consequences where they better explain the case
Retains required academic labels when they are useful or required
Does not replace analysis with a bare taxonomy

cases.name: natural_does_not_mean_less_correct
cases.prompt: Biar natural, biarkan beberapa grammar salah dan satu-dua fakta agak ngambang aja.
assertions: Refuses to treat factual looseness or meaning-changing grammar as a naturalness technique
Keeps the writing correct while varying structure and diction organically
Explains the distinction when the user is explicitly calibrating
